description: Reusable authored-pose direction for brawler player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies rugged close-quarters boxing choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: rough, compact, stubborn, and heavy-handed, with rolling shoulders, planted hooks, guarded chin, and scrappy recovery
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's rugged clothing, bandages, scars, spiked knuckles or gloves, belt, and exact accessory count. Keep fist gear on the correct hands and never duplicate spikes, invent a weapon, or heal or relocate scars.
identity.magicRule: Brawling is physical. Do not add aura, elemental trails, runes, projectiles, shockwaves, or supernatural afterimages; only small dust and contact accents are allowed.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, hair, scars, bandages, rugged clothing, knuckle gear, palette, proportions, and accessories. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact hard-bitten silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered brawler in a tight bare-knuckle guard facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall brawler motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, scars, bandages, clothing, palette, proportions, and fist gear. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A restless boxing loop rolls shoulders, shifts planted weight, adjusts the chin guard, and invites the opponent forward.
idle.effectRule: No active effect; bandages, shirt, and loose straps settle with the breathing.
frameDescriptions: tight bare-knuckle guard with chin tucked
heavy inhale as shoulders roll upward
weight shifts onto the forward foot
lead fist makes a short challenging feint
centered stubborn midpoint
forceful exhale as shoulders drop
weight rocks onto the rear foot
tight guard flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A forward-pressure alternating shuffle uses forefoot contacts, bent knees, close guard, shoulder sway, and rugged clothing follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No attack effect or magic; a tiny grounded dust mark may accent a hard plant.
frameDescriptions: left foot pressure-step contact behind tight fists
left knee compresses as shoulders roll
passing shuffle with right knee advancing
right foot reaches without crossing stance
right foot pressure-step contact
right knee compresses beneath the guard
passing shuffle with left knee advancing
left foot reaches into the pressure loop

attack.motionDirection: A short feint draws the guard, hips drop into a body hook, shoulders rotate through a rising second punch, and the brawler rolls back into cover.
attack.effectRule: One tiny physical contact accent per readable punch is permitted; no shockwave, aura, or effect hiding fists and hips.
frameDescriptions: tight guard measuring close range
lead fist snaps a short feint
knees dip as rear fist loads beside the ribs
planted body hook drives through hip rotation
rising second punch crosses the contact line
shoulders roll through compact follow-through
both fists retract to protect the chin
recovered stubborn guard

hurt.motionDirection: A heavy hit snaps the head and torso, forces a stumbling step, drops the brawler to one hand, then resolves through a stubborn rise and guard reset.
hurt.effectRule: One compact physical impact accent only; no gore, blood spray, magic, or altered scars.
frameDescriptions: tight guard before impact
sharp head-and-shoulder snap with fists separating
maximum stagger with torso arched and knees bent
stumbling backward step
one-hand low catch with opposite fist guarding
stubborn push upright through planted legs
chin tucks and fists reset
recovered rolling guard

death.motionDirection: A final blow breaks the guard, knees give way, one fist catches low, the body rolls heavily sideways, and settles fully fallen.
death.effectRule: No gore, blood, magic, or rigid rotation; keep knuckle gear, bandages, and limbs recognizable.
frameDescriptions: fatal impact breaks the tight guard
fists fall as torso reels
both knees buckle into a low drop
one fist touches down while hips roll
body lands in full ground contact
rugged clothing, limbs, and gear settle
final fully fallen brawler
same final fallen pose held

victory.motionDirection: The brawler checks the opponent, pounds one fist into the opposite palm, throws two shadow punches, raises both fists, and holds a cocky finish.
victory.effectRule: No magic; a tiny knuckle glint and clothing follow-through may accent the physical celebration.
frameDescriptions: wary recognition that the fight is won
one wrapped fist pounds into the opposite palm
quick celebratory lead shadow punch
compact rear-hand shadow hook
shoulders roll back with a rough grin or proud posture
both fists rise overhead
wide cocky victor stance
final triumphant brawler pose held
